en: The calibration error must stay below 0.8 millimetres.
zh: 校准误差不得超过0.8毫米。
why: Recorded v0.2.8 failure or long-tail case: H28-02

en: Participants were monitored for 72 hours without interruption.
zh: 参与者接受连续三天的监测。
why: Recorded v0.2.8 failure or long-tail case: H28-03

en: Tables must use a font size between 9 and 11 points, inclusive.
zh: 表格字体大小须在9至12磅之间（包含两端）。
why: Recorded v0.2.8 failure or long-tail case: H28-04

en: When consent is withdrawn, the recording must be deleted unless the law requires retention.
zh: 撤回同意后应删除录音，但法律要求留存的除外。
why: Recorded v0.2.8 failure or long-tail case: H28-13

en: The figure must be at least 1.2 centimetres wide.
zh: 图像宽度不得低于12毫米。

en: Participants were monitored for 72 hours without interruption. The audio files must be archived.
zh: 参与者接受连续三天的监测。录音文件可以删除。
why: equal time but conflicting archiving obligations
